mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an important institution in all societies."
Education is an important institution in all societies.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is concerned with man's activities in relation to the production, distribution and consumption of goods and services."
Economy is concerned with man's activities in relation to the production, distribution and consumption of goods and services.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is one of the fundamental courses for Postgraduate Diploma (PGD) in Agricultural Extension and Management Programme in any University in the world at large."
Rural Sociology is one of the fundamental courses for Postgraduate Diploma (PGD) in Agricultural Extension and Management Programme in any University in the world at large.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is concerned with when a number of people come together to share certain values and interests and thereby identify closely with each other."
Social group is concerned with when a number of people come together to share certain values and interests and thereby identify closely with each other.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is used to measure the level of fertility of the rural populations."
Fertility ratio is used to measure the level of fertility of the rural populations.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ refers to a system of farming whereby the farmer alternates between cropping and fallow periods."
Shifting cultivation refers to a system of farming whereby the farmer alternates between cropping and fallow periods.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ refers to the use police, the prison to ensure conformity with society's norms."
Formal social control refers to the use police, the prison to ensure conformity with society's norms.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ refers to a change in ideas, norms, values, roles and social habits of a people."
Social change refers to a change in ideas, norms, values, roles and social habits of a people.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ refers to the number of deaths per 1000 persons in the population."
Mortality rate refers to the number of deaths per 1000 persons in the population.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the mainstay of the rural economy, but which has been practiced with old and crude methods."
Agriculture is the mainstay of the rural economy, but which has been practiced with old and crude methods.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ refers to the number of births per year per 1000 women in the population of a place."
Fertility rate refers to the number of births per year per 1000 women in the population of a place.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the division of people into various social classes."
Social stratification is the division of people into various social classes.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are the community development worker, the Agricultural Extension Officer, Medical Officer, the main maker, Doctor, diviner and he Pastor at the local level."
Examples of professional leaders are the community development worker, the Agricultural Extension Officer, Medical Officer, the main maker, Doctor, diviner and he Pastor at the local level.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a statement that expresses the belief that one condition or thing is related in a specific way to another condition or thing."
Hypothesis is a statement that expresses the belief that one condition or thing is related in a specific way to another condition or thing.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the predominant type of group interaction because they know each other very well, for example, childhood intimacy brings people to have strong loyalty to one another over a long period of time."

Primary group is the predominant type of group interaction because they know each other very well, for example, childhood intimacy brings people to have strong loyalty to one another over a long period of time.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a life long process, we continue learning everyday about life."
socialization is a life long process, we continue learning everyday about life.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a person initiating interaction more frequently with other group members of a group or with any one else in a group or moves the group towards group goals."
A leader is a person initiating interaction more frequently with other group members of a group or with any one else in a group or moves the group towards group goals.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ refers to the number of males per 1000 females in the population."
Sex ratio refers to the number of males per 1000 females in the population.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ refers to the process of changing raw materials or inputs into consumable goods."
Production refers to the process of changing raw materials or inputs into consumable goods.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the total way of life which is learned, shared or transmitted from one generation to another."
Culture is the total way of life which is learned, shared or transmitted from one generation to another.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the process of handing what is socially acquired to other people and other groups."
Socialisation is the process of handing what is socially acquired to other people and other groups.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ refers to a situation whereby an outsider on his own deliberately introduces a new idea into the social system."
Direct contact change refers to a situation whereby an outsider on his own deliberately introduces a new idea into the social system.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is defined as the ability to control the behaviour of others."
Power is defined as the ability to control the behaviour of others.
